own_solution.law: Doppler effect, moving source, stationary listener, still air: f' = f c/(c - v_s)
assumptions: direct approach along the line of sight

notes: All strata agree with my pass 1. Recomputed R answers: 449*343/323 = 476.802 Hz, 456*343/323 = 484.235 Hz, 464*343/323 = 492.731 Hz; base 467.245 Hz. The C cancellation expression simplifies to t2 - t1 = (c - vs)/(f c), independent of d, correct. For all listed distances (180-950 m) the siren is still approaching for many seconds, so the stated 'still approaching' condition is reachable. Minimal pairs (T5688/T8B99 violin vs siren; TEE83/TD410 earlier run vs this run) keep 16 Hz and differ only in attachment; TE5DD/T4EE7 are wording variants with the same 300 m. Numeral-free twins T62DC and TEDCB are by design.
